title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: In gradient descent, the learning rate is a positive scalar that determines the step size at each iteration while moving toward a minimum of a function.

title: Role of the Learning Rate
text: The learning rate is used to scale the gradient, which is a vector pointing in the direction of the steepest increase of the function. A negative learning rate would imply moving in the opposite direction, which is not the purpose of gradient descent.

title: Evaluating the Statement
